summary: How much of an allowance is used and when it starts over; it warns near the end and says when it is full.

props.name: value
props.description: How much of the allowance is used, in percent.

props.name: resets
props.description: When it starts over, such as `Resets Monday at 9:00`.

props.name: warnAt
props.description: The percent from which it warns.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the card and the bar. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: animated
props.description: The bar's fill as it moves. Turn it off for a meter that jumps, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.
